ITEM 1 | Crispy-looking strips of cooked meat, reddish-brown with darker caramelized edges and pale fatty streaks, flat sheet-like pieces about 15-18 cm long and 1-1.5 cm wide, lying in a curled, overlapping cluster at the upper left of the plate with a slight sheen | 45
ITEM 2 | Scrambled eggs, bright yellow with paler curds, soft and moist but holding clumped shape, irregular pieces with a fluffy, crumbly edge, spread across the lower left of the plate covering roughly a quarter of the plate, about 2-3 cm tall in the thickest part | 130
ITEM 3 | Sautéed mixed vegetables with thin julienned orange carrot strips, pale green sliced stalks, and darker green leafy pieces, glossy with a slight oily sheen, lying in a loose mound at the upper right of the plate, about 10 cm across | 70
ITEM 4 | Broccoli florets, deep green with some darker tips, bright and slightly glossy, cut into bite-sized florets about 2-4 cm across, clustered at the right side of the plate near the vegetable mix, roughly 1-2 cm tall | 75
